title: When Recommendations Go Wrong: Risks of Generated Content
supports_claim: Analyzes risks from content generation errors and recommendations leading to misinformation and reputational harm.
limitations: Study analyzes prototypes and simulations; not an audit of a commercial product.

title: Audience Targeting and Creator Outcomes
supports_claim: Industry report showing examples where targeting increased short-term views but led to audience churn in some segments.
limitations: Public report with aggregated examples; details vary by platform and dataset.

title: EU AI Act: Regulatory Framework and Timeline
supports_claim: Official EU guidance on risk-based AI regulation and impacted system categories.
limitations: Guidance evolves with implementation; applicability to specific content tools requires legal review.
